[Edit] After several patches, the vast bulk of my previous review remains true. Polish is being slowly added and the fear I had that the hero level system, after the trial period, would be pay to win has proven to be largely unfounded - the minor boosts are completely washed away in the roguelike rng nature of each match. [/Edit] This game has potential. The gameplay is fun, it's to be at least as balanced as teamfight tactics, all of the champions are unlocked from the start, it appears to be as free to play friendly as one could reasonably hope for in the two thousand and twenty fourth year of our lord. And arguably most importantly it has 100% less bugs than whatever rushed "AAA" game last released. For the bad, [i]something[/i] about this game feels janky or unpolished - I just can't quite place exactly what it is. There is naturally a premium currency and a battlepass. The gameplay extender is crates that drop the normal currency currency and the premium currency as well as champion upgrade shards, so far I've seen mostly crates that take 3hrs to open and one that takes 6hrs - naturally these can be rushed with premium currency and you cannot wait on more than one to open. The hero upgrade system, while being [i]technically[/i] pay to win, is nothing that can't be, in my experience so far, subverted with either the inherent roguelike randomness or playing better. Right now the only real issue I have with the game is that the community and playerbase is currently smol. In my 12 games I have encountered 3 opponents that I am certain are human players, the other 90 odd opponents I am almost certain were bots that range in skill from quadriplegic toddler to drunken frat boy - that is to say they're easily beatable but there's about a 5% chance they'll slip you up [spoiler]or maybe I'm just bad[/spoiler]. But even still as the game grows, this issue basically ought to stop existing. Ultimately it's a fun game that has plenty of room to grow and doesn't pander to whales.

After 3 hours of playing, I can say that the game is worth keeping an eye on. Unfortunately, the lobbies are currently being filled with bots, which will hopefully be changed quickly. The different arenas and then locking 2 traits also make each round different and varied. You can definitely take a look

Keep an eye on Steamcharts. This game, right now, is capping out at like 387 peak players all time. There were 3 servers, now there are 4. This splits the player base 4 ways, for some reason. This means that you are mostly going to be playing against bots. The problem is, once you get into 2000+ ELO, the bots just RNG their way into Legendary skills, consistently, which has a very strange feeling to it. Merge servers and nix the weighted pulls bots get. Once, or if, this game gets a larger pool of players, it'll become irrelevant. Other than those problems, pretty good take on the autobattler genre.

玩了有一段时间了，测试服的时候就玩过了，是在群里看到群友讨论然后关注的，原版的《选技大乱斗》和后来的斗蛐蛐和这个我都玩了，可能我在魔兽平台选技玩多了，给我的感觉是抄都抄不明白，别人已经有80分的作业了你才抄到30分。 选技我玩了500+小时，去年真是玩了好久，套路基本都尝试过了就有点腻了，但是和群友一起还是玩的挺开心的。 斗蛐蛐过年这一阵儿玩了大概80+小时，界面舒服技能炫酷，不太平衡玩多了就变成纯纯的运气游戏，但人多的时候也很好玩。 但你这个游戏就不太行，界面我看着难受乱糟糟的分不清哪里是哪里，希望教程可以告知的更详尽一点。再就是虽然建模很精美但是总让我感觉建模和技能图标不是一套的比较混搭，也感受不到那种拳拳到肉的打击感，两个英雄打架不够流畅也不够自然，就好像在播放有点卡的PPT，然后技能强度也不平衡有几个流派谁都打不过，组合在一起就玩的很闹。 当然优点也有，建模更精致，一部分英雄头像和立绘很帅，有几个全新的宝物胡起来的时候很爽（赢了偷别人技能的最爽），不同的场景有不同的效果会影响战局也很新颖，信使也很好看。 就这些吧，我其实没那么在乎画面精致，只要新颖玩起来有套路我就愿意玩，祝越做越好搞成更多新奇套路，加油！

This game offers a refreshing twist on the Auto Chess genre, allowing players to build and customize their favorite heroes in a Roguelike fashion. With 10 different combat genres to explore, each match feels like a new adventure filled with strategic decisions and intense battles. The game's stunning graphics and fast-paced gameplay keep me coming back for more, while the welcoming community and frequent updates ensure that there's always something new to discover. Whether you're a seasoned strategist or new to the genre, Alpha League offers a thrilling experience that's hard to put down.

needless to say, i like this better than tft and im addicted edit: there seems to be people complaining about skin costs, community and gameplay seem to be playing a whole different game than i have been 🤔 which is odd, because i really cannot find any issues with the game's current situation for skins and gameplay. i have felt nothing pay to win, sure it may seem odd having to level up your character to get them to have stronger skill level but u can still outplay people. lets say, youre in midgame, everyone has their 1st legendary from the trait they were all focusing, instead of going for some goofy ah trait, look at who is left alive and then build to beat them. weaponry? go evasion/frost (if they arent banned). if they are banned you can go for health to pray to live longer or healing but these arent consistently the best to go against weaponry frost? go health, evasion and healing can help too and always pick up anti-freeze cards. evasion kind of helps coz u can just upgrade the card that lets u dodge magic. mech works too as fake tank poison? go weaponry/health/healing/antidote loads of options to counter so i have no clue why people complain that the game is pay to win 🤔 as for skins, ive purchased 3 skins pretty easily with the help of the chest opening and just ranking up so ive no clue why people are complaining about it 🤔 when u can legitimately get it all for free all in all, i like the game and i genuinely enjoy vsing the bots too because they seem to be more skilled than the actual players in this game 😂 although i would like to state something, DO NOT GO SPELL YUKIMURA, THAT SHID IS GARBAGE AF 🙏 just do crit > weaponry, ull melt people real fast with it or u can just do crit > survivability

I played three games where I waited two minutes in queue until the room was populated with seven bots. On my fourth attempt, miraculously, a duo of other players joined, one of which named XxJEWMASTERxX. Got a decent chunk of the way into the match before three players connecting at the same time caused the US servers to have a meltdown, with the game getting increasingly nonfunctional until it finally kicked us all to desktop just when the finale was starting. It's a dead game, and it's dead for a reason. The game doesn't have enough concurrent players to justify five different region based servers, but it also desperately needs one singular server that can handle enough players to fill a lobby without overheating.

This is a fantastic game for those who like turn-based-ish roguelite, tactics against other players, and Auto Battlers alike. I like to play it while relaxing in the bath or when I'm catching up on news. I personally do not understand any of the bad reviews. There are a few characters I like more than the others because of my playstyle but all characters have fairly balanced strengths and weaknesses if you understand how to properly build and counter build. I had a ton of fun and I'm excited for Alpha League to come back in December. The UI is just a little bit clunky, something you will most likely forget if you enjoy the gameplay. I've heard some assets in game may be reused, far too close to another design from another company, or stolen. Neither of these things bother me as I'm in it for the gameplay and strategy within, hopefully they can clean some things up in the December release if assets truly were stolen.

Played this more than a handful of times so I have a good feel for this game. Terrible balance - the shield woman is completely overpowered, and locked behind a paywall. Yes, you need to buy her, and she is significantly better than other heroes. The art screams asset flip - and not even a high effort asset flip. The game is also pay to win, as rerolling heroes and rerolling your artifact choices (both have a large affect on your odds to win or lose) cost premium currency. You get premium currency by playing through a free track on the battlepass, but the quantity is so low it may as well not exist. This game also has gacha mechanics to unlock MTX and playable heroes, as if this is a mobile game. Please stay far away from this. This is shameful this was even funded in the first place.

There's only a superficial "game" here. This mobile app is a "roguelike autobattler" which just means they couldn't work out how to do content and they just needed some bare minimum to get people slapping their credit cards down and buying P2W stuff in the mobile app cash shop... make no mistake, this is not at all free. The game has a lot of potential, and I've had quite a bit of fun with it and even reached top 5 rank in South America. However, there are major flaws that just ruins the game after a while: [b]1. Pay to win:[/b] By using real money, you can buy rerolls (called Artifact Dice and Hero Relic) and use them in every match. These rerolls allow you to always get the best artifact/heroes for each map. Some heroes are also locked behind paywalls. [b]2. Extremely high GPU usage:[/b] Even though the game itself has very basic graphics (pretty much a mobile game), my GPU (1060 6GB) is constantly at around 80% usage. And that's while limiting the game to 60fps. Makes me feel like there's a cryptocurrency miner going on the background. [b]3. Buggy/weird mechanics:[/b] Even though there's a library ingame that tells you about most of the mechanics, the interaction between mechanics are far from intuitive, and some even feel bugged. The drafting phase also has very buggy hitboxes. Unfortunately, this is just another game with huge potential ruined by greed, as we've come so used to seeing in the current days.
